question: Manoj Sinha, who is the second Lieutenant Governor of the Union territory of Jammu and Kashmir, hails from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttar Pradesh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manoj Sinha** hails from **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• **Manoj Sinha** is an **Indian politician** and a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He served as the **Minister of State for Railways** from **2014 to 2019** in the **Government of India**.
 
• Sinha was elected as a **Member of Parliament** for the **Ghazipur constituency** in **Uttar Pradesh** in **1996, 1999,** and **2014.**
 
• He has held various positions within the BJP, including serving as the **party's national vice president**.
 
• Sinha has a background in engineering and holds a bachelor's degree in **civil engineering** from the** Indian Institute of Technology (BHU)** **Varanasi**.
 
• Sinha is known for his **accessibility and responsiveness** to the needs of his constituents, often personally addressing their concerns.
 
• He is known for his** clean and non-controversial image** in Indian politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The position of the **Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir** was established after an Act was passed in** August 2019** by the **Parliament of India**, which reorganized the state of **Jammu and Kashmir** into **two union territories, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh**, on **October 31, 2019**.
 
• **The first Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir** was IAS officer** Girish Chandra Murmu**.
 
• **Manoj Sinha** is the **second and current Lieutenant Governor **of the Union territory of **Jammu and Kashmir** as of 2023.
